Throughout project development, the JTA used its Armsdale facility for vehicle testing because this facility is capable of outdoor and indoor testing as well as outdoor AV operations. Eight vehicle platforms have been evaluated for U2C deployment over the past 3 years at the Armsdale facility. In September 2024, the state of Florida and the city of Jacksonville announced that the HOLON AV shuttle will be manufactured in Jacksonville, Florida, beginning in 2027. Branded the HOLON Urban, this vehicle will be manufactured and assembled in a high-volume production facility by HOLON, a subsidiary of BENTELER—a major German supplier to the automotive industry. The HOLON Urban vehicle will be built in a dedicated factory, with ultimate production capability of 5,000 units per year. The JTA’s project is an early application site for the HOLON Urban. It complements the Jacksonville Transportation Authority’s innovative work in this space and the University of Florida’s downtown campus that will offer artificial intelligence degrees in the future. We welcome the jobs, expertise and global recognition that HOLON will bring to Jacksonville. (Weber 2024) Figure 18 provides a view of the HOLON Urban interior and exterior design details.
